propositions: A ticket whose context exceeds 24,000 chars is rejected by bounded recovery before any model call, blocking correct merged work from reaching closed state
Bounded recovery reports step-budget exhaustion as missing dependency (install agents extra) instead of the actual cause, misattributing a failure that demonstrably ran the model
The criteria character budget (32,000) exceeds the context budget (24,000), creating an incoherent bound where criteria sets can pass all criteria checks but fail on context validation
An earlier compaction design that dropped comment history silently deleted entire child tickets and their unmet criteria on epic closes while misreporting it as comment elision
Recovery must reject over-cap payloads with zero billable calls and must preserve byte-identical context on every per-criterion call to prevent invisible false passes
